AchievementView.description: An achievement of the career's content with its Polish ICU name and description, its points and whether it is earned (earned first).

ActionRequest.description: Only the fields of the chosen ActionType ActionRequest.Type are needed; the others may be omitted.

AuditRecordView.description: An audit record: who changed what and why, with the values before and after as JSON text.

AutoOfferView.description: A sponsor offer the batch answered before planning the week, with the policy's reason.

CareerOptionsView.description: What character creation may choose, with the numbers of the content new careers start on.

CareerView.description: A career as the client sees it at one version (and the ruleset and, if ranked, season it plays for life); also the stored response of each step.

CategoryPlan.description: How a strategy picks the week's category.

ChoiceView.description: A response with its odds, the viral chance a critical outcome adds and why the career cannot take it (needs-cash, needs-energy), if so.

ContentAdminView.description: The newest publication and the owner's draft, if any.

ContentDiffView.description: What a draft changes: items, values, and whether it changes mechanics (a new season), only texts, or nothing.

ContentDraftView.description: The draft with its check: problems that block publication and the diff against the newest publication.

ContentExportView.description: Both files of a publication as their exact stored text, so their SHA-256 reproduces the digest.

ContentPublicationView.description: A publication: its number, digest, mechanics fingerprint, kind, the publication it copies, who published it, why and when.

ContractView.description: An accepted sponsor deal: its next due week, the term end, the misses so far and whether it is due this week.

CreateCareerRequest.description: Guid? CreateCareerRequest.CreationId is a fresh random UUID per creation; repeating it repeats the creation (TD-121). A ranked career plays for the open season (TD-122).

CreatedCareer.description: The new career; string CreatedCareer.Secret and string CreatedCareer.RecoveryKey are returned only here and never stored.

CreateDraftRequest.description: Creates the draft from the newest publication, or from int? CreateDraftRequest.FromPublication.

DraftBalanceRequest.description: The whole balance document at the revision the owner read.

DraftEventRequest.description: An event to put into the draft at the revision the owner read; its `id` equals the path.

DraftEventView.description: An event of the draft: its ID, version, phase and title for the list, and the whole event as JSON.

EndingSummaryView.description: What the ending narrative is built from: reason, weeks, dominant category, reputation, platforms, peak follower milestone and earned achievements.

EntryStatus.description: What the ending screen can offer for a career's result.

EntryStatusView.description: Whether and until when a career can publish its result, and the published entry with its season rank.

EventView.description: An event to answer: M1 gives a title key and plain text, M3 an ICU title and text that the client formats; mandatory marks a decision between weeks.

HistoryView.description: Every settled week of a career, in week order (M3-D).

ImportCareerRequest.description: The exported save file as it was downloaded (spec M4-C §5).

IssuedRecoveryKey.description: A new recovery key, shown once; the previous key no longer opens the career.

ItemDiffView.description: An event or sponsor template that differs from the newest publication; mechanical unless only its texts or version changed.

LeaderboardRowView.description: A public leaderboard row: only the fields every visitor may see.

LeaderboardView.description: A season's top entries in leaderboard order.

MainAction.description: Between-stream main actions, one per week; networking is M3 only, the last three need M3-B balance sections.

MigrationEstimateView.description: A platform move: the retention and follower range, whether this use executes it, and the target platform's factors.

MigrationView.description: A completed platform move with the retention and the followers before and after.

ModeratedEntryView.description: An entry as the owner sees it: the public fields, its receipt, whether and why it is hidden, and its public rank while visible.

ModeratedSeasonView.description: A season with every one of its entries.

ModerationRequest.description: Why the owner hides or restores an entry; kept in the audit record.

NextStepKind.description: What the player can do next.

NextStepView.description: IReadOnlyList<PlanOptionView> NextStepView.Plans is filled for NextStepKind.PlanWeek, EventView? NextStepView.Event for NextStepKind.ResolveEvent and NextStepKind.ResolveDecision.

OfferView.description: A sponsor offer with every term shown before acceptance and why it cannot be accepted now, if so.

OwnerCodeRequest.description: Either the authenticator app's six-digit code or one unused recovery code.

OwnerLoginRequest.description: The owner's user name and password, the first sign-in step.

OwnerLoginStep.description: The next sign-in step after a correct password: always the second factor.

OwnerSessionView.description: The signed-in owner, the anti-forgery token for admin writes, and how many recovery codes are left.

PlanOptionView.description: A plan with the reason it is disabled, the odds of a rolled action and what it risks: wager terms, policy exposure, a platform move and sponsor consequences.

PolicyExposureView.description: The week's policy exposure, the strike chance and the 1–100 threshold of the strike roll.

code.description: Stable error code, for example stale-version.

errors.description: Field errors of validation-failed, keyed by camelCase field name.

PronounSet.description: Grammatical form only; no rule may read it.

PublicationKind.description: Kind of a publication: the repository content, a draft, or a copy of an earlier publication.

PublishContentRequest.description: Publishes the draft at the revision the owner checked, for a reason kept in the audit record.

PublishedEntryView.description: A career's own published entry; the rank is null while the owner hides the entry.

PublishResultRequest.description: Only the nickname: the server publishes the score it computed, and any other field is ignored.

RecoveredCareer.description: The recovered career and its new browser secret; the previous secret no longer opens it.

Reputation.description: How the audience remembers the streamer at the end of a career.

RestoreSlotRequest.description: Guid RestoreSlotRequest.CommandId makes the restore safe to repeat, like a command (spec M4-C §3).

RiskAppetite.description: How much a strategy gambles on event choices and how much drama it tolerates.

RollView.description: A roll with the authored title, label and outcome text of the career's snapshot (M3-D); the texts are absent in responses stored before them.

SaveFile.description: An exported unranked career: the canonical state without history; unsigned, validated on import (spec M4-C §5).

SaveSlotsView.description: The three manual slots of an unranked career, in slot order.

SaveSlotView.description: One manual slot: empty, or the week, cash and followers of the saved state and when it was saved.

SaveToSlotRequest.description: The state version the player is looking at; a stale one is rejected (spec M4-C §3).

ScoreView.description: The final score: the normalised components, their points, the base score, both multipliers and the total.

SeasonExtensionRequest.description: The later deadline of a closed season and why it moves.

SeasonView.description: A season with its dates; the deadline is null while it is open, and extended once the owner announced a later one.

SideBusinessView.description: The text-only side business: when it opened, its quality and the income it pays at the next settlement.

SimulationRunView.description: One simulated batch: how many careers, their endings, score and length spread, and every broken invariant or error.

SimulationView.description: The draft and the current content replayed on the same seeds, policies, backgrounds and difficulties.

SponsorConsequenceView.description: A missed installment or breach the plan would cause: missedInstallment or breach, the penalty, the credibility change and whether the deal ends.

SponsorKind.description: M3-B: a one-off sponsor deal or a multi-week contract.

SpreadView.description: Percentiles 10, 50 and 90 of one measure over the simulated careers.

StrategyInput.description: The player's strategy for a batch (M3-C spec §5), as the contract carries it.

StrikeRollView.description: The week's policy exposure and strike roll (no roll without exposure), and whether it banned the platform.

StrikeView.description: An active policy strike on a platform and the last settled week in which it still counts.

TelemetryAccepted.description: How many events of the batch were counted.

TelemetryEvent.description: One gameplay event as the browser sends it; only allowlisted names and values are counted (spec M4-F §2).

TelemetryRequest.description: Opted-in gameplay events: only allowlisted names and values, counted per day (spec M4-F §2).

ValueDiffView.description: A balance or events-file value that differs, by JSON path, with both values as JSON text.

ViralView.description: A viral clip: the 1–100 roll against the threshold, the viewer multiplier and the follower bonus.

WagerResultView.description: The week's wager: the stake, the 1–100 roll against the win threshold and the net cash.

WeekReportView.description: A settled week with the decision rolls, the action roll, its viral clip, the strike roll, the wager and a platform move.

WeekSummaryView.description: One settled week in the history list: its plan, audience and cash, whether a batch played it, and its incident tags.

careerSecret.description: The career secret returned once by createCareer, sent as Authorization: Bearer <secret>.

owner.description: The owner's sign-in cookie; a POST also sends the X-CSRF-TOKEN header from getOwnerSession.
owner.name: pss.owner
